name: forever-twins-harness
description: Forever Twins simnet evidence, v2 acceptance tests, source screener and read-only live checks. No keys, no broadcasts.

scripts.render: node scripts/render-helper.mjs scripts/configs/simnet-zombie-wabbits.json contracts/rendered/ft2-zombie-wabbits.clar && node scripts/render-helper.mjs scripts/configs/simnet-gamma-pepe.json contracts/rendered/ft2-gamma-pepe.clar
scripts.test: npm run test:existing && npm run test:v2 && npm run test:shared-probe && npm run test:live-check
scripts.screen: python3 screener/screen_sources.py screener/sources > results/screen.json && python3 screener/summarise.py results/screen.json
